summary: Lower general JavaScript addition through a semantics helper when coercion or BigInt is possible.

target.notes: ToPrimitive both operands; if either resulting primitive is String concatenate after ToString, otherwise ToNumeric and require matching numeric kinds.

semantics.evaluation_order: left expression, right expression, then required coercions in specification order
semantics.coercion: ToPrimitive both operands; if either resulting primitive is String concatenate after ToString, otherwise ToNumeric and require matching numeric kinds.
semantics.result_type: Number or BigInt, except addition may also return String

caveats: Object coercion may invoke user-defined valueOf/toString/Symbol.toPrimitive with side effects or exceptions.
Symbol operands can make numeric/string coercion throw TypeError.

tests.name: edge addition numeric-kind behavior
tests.expected_behavior: throws TypeError because BigInt and Number cannot be mixed
